Subject: Transit Harbor — initial vendor onboarding items for EU VAT handling

Hi Marta,

Thanks again for agreeing to set up Transit Harbor as a Redwood supplier. To get the PO and invoice pipeline moving for EU shipments we need the following from your side:

- Valid VAT registration certificate (PDF) that shows your PL VAT number and effective date
- Legal registered name and tax domicile (company registry extract is fine)
- Bank details for SEPA payments (IBAN + BIC) and confirmation of whether payouts should be to Transit Harbor Sp. z o.o. or a UK/EU affiliate
- A sample invoice in English that includes VAT breakdown (we use this to validate our parsing rules)

If Transit Harbor expects reverse-charge treatment for any lines, please flag which service/goods categories apply and include any fiscal representative info if relevant.

I'll route the docs to Finance and Tax once received — copying Ben and Laura for PO entity mapping decisions.

Can you send these by end of day Thursday so we can complete the PO activation this week?

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks — attaching the documents requested. A few notes up front:

- VAT certificate attached (TransitHarbor-VAT-Certificate-PL.pdf). VAT number: PL1234567890.
- Legal name on registry: Transit Harbor Sp. z o.o.; tax domicile Poland.
- We operate under Transit Harbor Sp. z o.o. for EU sales; we do not have a UK branch.
- Bank details in attached spreadsheet — payouts to the Polish entity only.
- For shipments of equipment (hardware), VAT is charged on our invoices. For logistics consulting (service lines) we typically apply reverse-charge for B2B clients within the EU — we'll flag line items on the sample invoice.

We do not currently use a fiscal representative. If Redwood prefers invoices routed to a different legal entity for PO purposes, let us know and we'll discuss.

Attachments: TransitHarbor-VAT-Certificate-PL.pdf; TransitHarbor-Bank-Details-EU.xlsx; SampleInvoice-English.pdf

Best,
Marta Kowalska

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: connor_obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, m.marta@transitharbor.pl
Date: 2026-11-18 10:27:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Transit Harbor — VAT evidence received / PO entity question

Eve / Laura — thanks for the uploads, Marta. Quick notes from tax/PO perspective:

- The PL VAT cert looks valid and includes the registration start date. Good to accept for VAT-proof.
- Because Transit Harbor invoices from the Polish entity and wants payouts to PL IBAN, we should map POs to the EU billing entity in our procurement system (not the UK or US ledger).
- For service lines where Transit Harbor intends reverse-charge, we need them to include the notation on the invoice ("reverse charge — Article 44" or equivalent) and to provide a line-level description. Our AP parser currently expects the reverse-charge flag in the invoice reference field; if absent AP will apply standard VAT treatment and hold the invoice.

Ask: Laura, can you confirm the PO entity code for Poland (should be EU-PL-TRH) and whether we need to split POs by tax-treatment (goods vs services) so AP can route correctly? If splitting is required, we should provide Transit Harbor the PO template showing separate lines and GL mapping.

Connor — if AP needs any transformation scripts for the invoice parser to accept the sample invoice layout, please advise; we can schedule a quick handover.

Ben Carter
Finance Operations (tax liaison)
Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-11-20 14:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Transit Harbor — VAT evidence received / PO entity question

Thanks team — confirmed:

- PO entity code EU-PL-TRH exists; I've created placeholder PO 2109-TRH-PL pending final approval.
- We will issue a single PO but include split line-items so AP can route VAT-charged lines to the goods ledger and reverse-charge lines to the services ledger. Please see attached PO template which has the GL/Tax-treatment columns filled for Transit Harbor.
- Marta — two small asks before activating: (1) on future invoices please include the PL VAT number next to your company name on the header; (2) for any reverse-charge lines include the text "Reverse charge — B2B EU" in the invoice notes field. That will prevent AP holds.

If no objections I'll push the PO to Transit Harbor and cc AP for onboarding. Evelyn, if you can confirm acceptance from Transit Harbor we'll move to DocuSign for the master purchase agreement.

Laura Bennett
Senior Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference
